title: GDPR Compliance Request Letter Template - Exercise Your Rights
metaDescription: Free GDPR compliance request letter template to exercise your data protection rights. Includes templates for access, deletion, and rectification requests.
description: Professional letter templates to help you exercise your GDPR rights. Whether you need to request data access, deletion, rectification, or portability, these templates ensure your requests comply with EU regulations and get proper attention from organizations.

sections.heading: Subject Access Request (Article 15)
sections.content:
Subject: Data Subject Access Request under GDPR Article 15

Dear Data Protection Officer,

I am writing to request access to all personal data you hold about me under Article 15 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

I request the following information:
- Confirmation of whether you process my personal data
- Categories of personal data processed
- Purposes of processing
- Recipients or categories of recipients
- Retention periods
- Source of data if not collected directly from me
- Existence of automated decision-making or profiling

Please provide this information within 30 days as required by law. If you require additional information to verify my identity, please contact me at [YOUR_EMAIL].

Sincerely,
[YOUR_NAME]
[DATE]

sections.heading: Right to Erasure Request (Article 17)
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Erasure of Personal Data under GDPR Article 17

Dear Data Protection Officer,

I hereby request the immediate erasure of all my personal data under Article 17 of the GDPR (Right to be Forgotten).

The grounds for this request are:
☐ The personal data is no longer necessary for the original purpose
☐ I withdraw my consent and there is no other legal basis for processing
☐ My personal data has been unlawfully processed
☐ Erasure is required for compliance with a legal obligation
☐ Other: [SPECIFY_REASON]

I also request that you inform any third parties to whom my data has been disclosed about this erasure request.

Please confirm completion of this request within 30 days.

Sincerely,
[YOUR_NAME]
[DATE]

placeholders.label: Other specific reason
placeholders.defaultValue: Please specify if other reason applies

sections.heading: Data Rectification Request (Article 16)
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Rectification of Personal Data under GDPR Article 16

Dear Data Protection Officer,

I am writing to request the rectification of inaccurate personal data you hold about me under Article 16 of the GDPR.

The following information is inaccurate and needs correction:

Incorrect information: [INCORRECT_DATA]
Correct information: [CORRECT_DATA]

Incorrect information: [INCORRECT_DATA_2]
Correct information: [CORRECT_DATA_2]

I also request that you communicate these rectifications to any recipients to whom my personal data has been disclosed.

Please confirm these corrections have been made within 30 days.

Sincerely,
[YOUR_NAME]
[DATE]

sections.heading: Data Portability Request (Article 20)
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Data Portability under GDPR Article 20

Dear Data Protection Officer,

I request the portability of my personal data under Article 20 of the GDPR.

Please provide my personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format. I request data that:
- I have provided to you
- Is processed based on consent or contract
- Is processed by automated means

Preferred format: ☐ CSV ☐ JSON ☐ XML ☐ Other: [PREFERRED_FORMAT]

☐ I also request that you transmit this data directly to: [THIRD_PARTY_ORGANIZATION]
Contact details: [THIRD_PARTY_CONTACT]

Please complete this request within 30 days.

Sincerely,
[YOUR_NAME]
[DATE]

sections.heading: Contact Information Template
sections.content:
My Details:
Full Name: [YOUR_FULL_NAME]
Email Address: [YOUR_EMAIL]
Phone Number: [YOUR_PHONE]
Account ID/Username: [ACCOUNT_ID]
Address: [YOUR_ADDRESS]

Identity Verification:
I am happy to provide additional identification if required. Please let me know what documentation you need.

Response Method:
Please respond to this request via: ☐ Email ☐ Post ☐ Secure portal

Note: Under GDPR, you have 30 days to respond to this request. If you need additional time or cannot fulfill this request, please explain the reasons why.
